<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Implement an unsigned 8bit multiplier based on pipelining processing.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_DOUBLE">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic id="mul_en_out_reg">
            <description>mul_en_out_reg is a 3-bit register that stores the input enable signal mul_en_in. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal clk. The register is reset to 0 when the reset signal rst_n is active (0). The register is updated by concatenating its previous two bits with the current value of mul_en_in.</description>
            <initial_value>[3'h0]</initial_value>
            <always>
                <description>Update mul_en_out_reg on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n.</description>
                <trigger id="clk" edge="posedge"/>
                <trigger id="rst_n" edge="negedge"/>
                <if>
                    <condition id="rst_n" value="0"/>
                    <true>
                        <description>Reset mul_en_out_reg to 0 when rst_n is 0.</description>
                        <assignment id="mul_en_out_reg" value="[3'h0]"/>
                    </true>
                    <false>
                        <description>Update mul_en_out_reg by concatenating its previous two bits with the current value of mul_en_in.</description>
                        <assignment id="mul_en_out_reg" value="{{mul_en_out_reg[1:0]}, mul_en_in}"/>
                    </false>
                </if>
            </always>
        </sequential_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="mul_en_out">
            <description>mul_en_out is the output enable signal that indicates if the multiplication operation is enabled. It is derived from the most significant bit of mul_en_out_reg.</description>
            <assignment id="mul_en_out" value="mul_en_out_reg[2]"/>
        </combinational_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="mul_a_reg">
            <description>mul_a_reg is a 8-bit register that stores the input multiplicand mul_a. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal clk. The register is reset to 0 when the reset signal rst_n is active (0). The register is updated by assigning the value of mul_a to mul_a_reg when mul_en_in is active.</description>
            <initial_value>[8'h00]</initial_value>
            <always>
                <description>Update mul_a_reg on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n.</description>
                <trigger id="clk" edge="posedge"/>
                <trigger id="rst_n" edge="negedge"/>
                <if>
                    <condition id="rst_n" value="0"/>
                    <true>
                        <description>Reset mul_a_reg to 0 when rst_n is 0.</description>
                        <assignment id="mul_a_reg" value="[8'h00]"/>
                    </true>
                    <false>
                        <description>Update mul_a_reg with the value of mul_a when mul_en_in is active.</description>
                        <if>
                            <condition id="mul_en_in" value="1"/>
                            <true>
                                <assignment id="mul_a_reg" value="mul_a"/>
                            </true>
                        </if>
                    </false>
                </if>
            </always>
        </sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="mul_b_reg">
            <description>mul_b_reg is a 8-bit register that stores the input multiplier mul_b. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal clk. The register is reset to 0 when the reset signal rst_n is active (0). The register is updated by assigning the value of mul_b to mul_b_reg when mul_en_in is active.</description>
            <initial_value>[8'h00]</initial_value>
            <always>
                <description>Update mul_b_reg on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n.</description>
                <trigger id="clk" edge="posedge"/>
                <trigger id="rst_n" edge="negedge"/>
                <if>
                    <condition id="rst_n" value="0"/>
                    <true>
                        <description>Reset mul_b_reg to 0 when rst_n is 0.</description>
                        <assignment id="mul_b_reg" value="[8'h00]"/>
                    </true>
                    <false>
                        <description>Update mul_b_reg with the value of mul_b when mul_en_in is active.</description>
                        <if>
                            <condition id="mul_en_in" value="1"/>
                            <true>
                                <assignment id="mul_b_reg" value="mul_b"/>
                            </true>
                        </if>
                    </false>
                </if>
            </always>
        </sequential_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="temp[0]">
            <description>temp[0] is a 8-bit wire that stores the partial product generated by the bitwise AND operation between the least significant bit of mul_a_reg and the least significant bit of mul_b_reg. It is updated based on the value of mul_en_in. If mul_en_in is active, temp[0] is updated with the partial product. If mul_en_in is inactive, temp[0] is set to 0.</description>
            <if>
                <condition id="mul_en_in" value="1"/>
                <true>
                    <assignment id="temp[0]" value="mul_a_reg[0] & mul_b_reg[0]"/>
                </true>
                <false>
                    <assignment id="temp[0]" value="1'b0"/>
                </false>
            </if>
        </combinational_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="temp[1]">
            <description>temp[1] is a 8-bit wire that stores the partial product generated by the bitwise AND operation between the least significant bit of mul_a_reg and the second least significant bit of mul_b_reg. It is updated based on the value of mul_en_in. If mul_en_in is active, temp[1] is updated with the partial product. If mul_en_in is inactive, temp[1] is set to 0.</description>
            <if>
                <condition id="mul_en_in" value="1"/>
                <true>
                    <assignment id="temp[1]" value="mul_a_reg[0] & mul_b_reg[1]"/>
                </true>
                <false>
                    <assignment id="temp[1]" value="1'b0"/>
                </false>
            </if>
        </combinational_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="temp[2]">
            <description>temp[2] is a 8-bit wire that stores the partial product generated by the bitwise AND operation between the least significant bit of mul_a_reg and the third least significant bit of mul_b_reg. It is updated based on the value of mul_en_in. If mul_en_in is active, temp[2] is updated with the partial product. If mul_en_in is inactive, temp[2] is set to 0.</description>
            <if>
                <condition id="mul_en_in" value="1"/>
                <true>
                    <assignment id="temp[2]" value="mul_a_reg[0] & mul_b_reg[2]"/>
                </true>
                <false>
                    <assignment id="temp[2]" value="1'b0"/>
                </false>
            </if>
        </combinational_logic>
        <combinational_logic id="temp[3]">
            <description>temp[3] is a 8-bit wire that stores the partial product generated by the bitwise AND operation between the least significant bit of mul_a_reg and the fourth least significant bit of mul_b_reg.             <if>
                <condition id="mul_en_in" value="1"/>
                <true>
                    <assignment id="temp[3]" value="mul_a_reg[0] & mul_b_reg[3]"/>
